content: Arrawen n Arebbi
Xseɣ ad iniɣ, mecḥař ma d awrit aqa-t ɛad d aḥenjir, war din bu řfarq x umsexxar, waxxa netta d bab n marra nitni.
Netta iǧa ɛad sadu imeḥdayen u sadu inni ittseyyaren taddart ař řweqt i yegga babas.
Ammu ɛawed neccin, umi d aneɣ tuɣa ɛad d iḥenjiren, tuɣa aneɣ d isemɣan sadu ṣṣulṭa n lfarayiḍ n ddunect-a.
Maca umi dd-yiweḍ uɛemmar n řweqt, AREBBI aqa issekk-dd Mmis i yeǧan zi temɣart d wenni iǧan sadu Ccariɛa,
ḥima ad ifdi inni iǧan sadu Ccariɛa uca xenni neccin ad neṭṭef řefḍeř maḥend ad nettwaqbeř d mmis.
Minzi kenniw teǧam d arrawen, AREBBI issekk Arruḥ n Mmis deg wuřawen nwem, wenni ittřaɣan: ‘Baba, Babatneɣ!’
S uyenni war teǧim ɛad d imsexxaren, maca d arrawen u mařa arrawen i teǧam, aqa kenniw ɛawed d iwriten n AREBBI s Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Maca di zzman i war tessinem ca AREBBI, tuɣa tɛebbdem inni war iǧin s tewwa d irebbiten.
Maca řexxu, awarni řami tessnem AREBBI, ɛad ḥsen AREBBI yargeb xawem, aqa tɛeqbem ɛawed ɣar ṣṣulṭa n lfarayiḍ iḍeɛfen izeřḍen n ddunect-a, texsem ɛawed ad asent tᵉmmarsem ixef nwem am zeg wecḥař uya!
Tḥeṭṭam ussan d iyuren d zzmanat d iseggʷusa.
Ttᵉggʷedeɣ xawem aqa ttamareɣ jar awem x walu.
Tɣuyyit n deɣya
A aytma, ttzawageɣ kenniw, iřim am necc, minzi necc am kenniw. Kenniw war d ayi teggim walu min war iḥřin.
Aqa kenniw tessnem belli barrḥeɣ awem-dd s Řexbar Aṣebḥan deg umezwaru s tuḍɛeft n arrimet inu.
Kenniw war tesseḥqarem niɣ tessṭeyyḥem zeg umarret n arrimet inu, maca tqebřem ayi am yijj n lmalak n AREBBI u am Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Mani truḥ xenni lbaraka nwem? Minzi cehhdeɣ xawem belli, mařa tuɣa tzemmarem, ad tqeřɛem tiṭṭawin nwem, ḥima ad ayi tent tewcem.
Ma dewřeɣ d řeɛdu nwem, minzi barrḥeɣ kenniw s tidett?
Nitni cḍaren aṭṭas xawem, maca war iǧi amenni waha, maɣar xsen ad kenniw ḥebbsen, ḥima kenniw ad tecḍarem xasen.
Wah, mliḥ ad tiřim řebda tceṭṭarem di min iǧan d aṣebḥan, maca war iǧi xmi kiwem i ɣa ḥḍareɣ waha.
A iḥenjiren inu, twařa nneɣnit aqa ayi i kenniw am yict n temɣart tenni iksin ddeyset zzaywem s unezbar n tarwa, ař daywem i ɣa iřint tefras n Lmasiḥ.
Xseɣ řexxu ad iřiɣ akidwem uca ad beddřeɣ tmijja inu, minzi aqa ugnuɣ zzaywem.
Amedya n Hajar d Sara
Inim ayi, kenniw inni ittexsen ad tiřim sadu Ccariɛa, ma war tᵉṭṭiɛem ca Ccariɛa?
Minzi aqa tura belli Ibrahim tuɣa ɣares tnayen n iḥenjiren, ijjen n tayya, wenneɣni n tḥurrect.
Wenni n tayya aqa ittwaxřeq-dd ɛlaḥsab ddat, maca wenni n tḥurrect ittwaxřeq-dd ɛlaḥsab lwaɛd.
Tina d tnayen n imedya n tnayen n řɛuhud, ijjen n wedrar n Sina, wenni i dd-ittarwen tasmuɣi, aqa-t Hajar.
Minzi Hajar d adrar n Sina di Ɛarabiyya, tenni yarewsen di Urcalim n řexxu, tenni iǧan di tesmuɣi ak-d tarwa nnes.
Maca Urcalim n sennej d taḥurrect, aqa-tt d yemmatneɣ.
Minzi tura:
“Farḥ, tenni war ittirwen ɛemmarṣ! Duqqez s usřiwřew, sɣuyy s jjehd, a cem tenni war issinen řewjeɛ n tarwa, maɣar tarwa n tenni di semḥen d aṭṭas x tarwa n tenni ɣar iǧa weryaz.”
Maca neccin a aytma, d tarwa n lwaɛd am Isḥaq.
Maca am di řweqt nni wi dd-itwaxeřqen ɛlaḥsab ddat tuɣa imarret wenni dd-ittwaxeřqen ɛlaḥsab Arruḥ, ammu ɛawed řexxu.
Maca min qqarent Tira Iqeddsen? “Nḍarem barra tayya d mmis, minzi war ittiři mmis n tayya d awrit ak-d mmis n tḥurrect.”
S uyenni, a aytma, aqa war neǧi ca d tarwa n tayya, maca tarwa n tḥurrect.
